title: VoxDesk production launch checklist
notes: Single source of truth for launch requirements. Evidence is recorded in scripts/release/evidence.json; no evidence means NOT_RUN, never PASS. P0/P1 items may not be waived. Real-provider items (realprov-*) and the manual E2E item (e2e-001) are populated by scripts/release_gate.py from real result files, never from the evidence file.

items.requirement: Code compiles and all modules import cleanly
items.evidence_hint: compileall + import-check over the app package (Step 10 quality gate)

items.requirement: Static analysis (ruff) passes the CI-fatal ruleset
items.evidence_hint: ruff check with the pyproject CI select set

items.requirement: Backend unit + integration test suite passes deterministically
items.evidence_hint: pytest tests/ (no real credentials; SQLite + bcrypt work factor 4)

items.requirement: Frontend unit tests pass and production build succeeds
items.evidence_hint: npm test + npm run build with production dependency audit

items.requirement: Release-gate logic tests pass
Security regression suite and SAST pass
Dependency vulnerability scan clean (no high/critical advisories)
Authentication and RBAC behavior verified by tests
Tenant isolation invariants verified by tests
Backend dependencies pinned and audit script passes
Database schema and constraints exercised by tests
items.evidence_hint: pytest tests/ (SQLite in-memory) covering models + constraints

items.requirement: Migration chain is linear and has a single recorded head
Deployment script and config validated (static) against the candidate artifact
items.evidence_hint: scripts/deploy.sh + docker compose config + deployment tests

items.requirement: Backup procedure is configured and verified
items.evidence_hint: docs/STEP10-BACKUP-SYNC.md runbook executed in staging; pg_dump/rclone evidence

items.requirement: Restore drill completed and verified in staging
items.evidence_hint: restore from latest backup, row-count + checksum verification

items.requirement: Off-site backup replication verified
items.evidence_hint: rclone sync + ls of off-site bucket (docs/STEP10-BACKUP-SYNC.md)

items.requirement: TLS termination configured and certificates valid on all public endpoints
items.evidence_hint: curl -v https endpoint + cert expiry check in staging

items.requirement: Metrics, structured logs, and tracing exported and verified
items.evidence_hint: prometheus /metrics scrape + log correlation + trace export in staging

items.requirement: Alerts are defined, routed, and tested (fired once)
items.evidence_hint: observability/alerts.yml + SLO-ALERTS.md runbooks + test fire in staging

items.requirement: Twilio connectivity verified (read-only)
Deepgram connectivity verified (read-only)
ElevenLabs connectivity verified (read-only)
OpenAI LLM connectivity verified (read-only)
Anthropic LLM connectivity verified (read-only)
Google LLM connectivity verified (read-only)
Google Calendar connectivity verified (read-only)
Microsoft Calendar connectivity verified (read-only)
Cal.com connectivity verified (read-only)
HubSpot connectivity verified (read-only)
GoHighLevel connectivity verified (read-only)
Jobber connectivity verified (read-only)
Stripe connectivity verified (read-only, no charges)
Full read-only health sweep of all 13 providers completed green
items.evidence_hint: aggregate of scripts/validate_providers.py results for all 13 providers (opt-in, read-only)

items.requirement: Human-controlled live voice call completed with pre-call/call/post-call evidence
Billing/metering/idempotency verified by tests
Cost model, budgets, and alerts configured and reviewed
Rate limiting verified by tests and configured in production
Abuse prevention controls (SSRF, E2E guard) verified by tests
Outbound egress network policy enforced (allowlist) and verified in staging
items.evidence_hint: docs/STEP10-EGRESS-POLICY.md applied; egress allowlist tested from staging (denied-by-default)

items.requirement: Privacy/GDPR/retention behavior verified by tests
Retention policy applied to recordings/transcripts and verified
items.evidence_hint: retention job run in staging + deletion verification

items.requirement: Compliance documentation reviewed and signed off
External penetration test performed by an independent third party
items.evidence_hint: third-party pentest report — NOT_RUN until a real third party performs it

items.requirement: Incident response runbook tested (tabletop or drill)
Disaster recovery plan tested in staging
items.evidence_hint: docs/BCP.md DR runbook + restore drill sign-off
